AIRSPACE.Definition: the sky above a country, which that country controls

ALLY.Definition: a friendly country that supports it and works with it

REVENUE.Definition: money that is earned or received

DETOUR.Definition: a longer route taken to avoid something

BOOMING.Definition: growing very quickly and doing very well

WARRANT.Definition: be a good enough reason for

PROHIBITED.Definition: not allowed by law or by official rules

INHABITANTS.Definition: the people who live in these places

OSTENSIBLY.Definition: according to the official reason, which may not be the whole truth
